name: MIRIX
description: Multi-agent personal assistant that builds structured long-term memory from screen activity and conversation.
whatItDoes: Observes what the user does on screen and what they say, then consolidates it into memories that later conversations can draw on. Long-term data is stored locally under user-controlled privacy settings.
howItWorks: Six memory components (core, episodic, semantic, procedural, resource and knowledge vault) are each managed by a dedicated agent. A Docker Compose backend exposes a dashboard and API, a Python client initialises a meta agent with an LLM config, and search uses PostgreSQL BM25 plus vector similarity.

requirements.name: MIRIX_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key created in the local dashboard and used by the client

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Model used by the meta agent, for example Gemini
